استحصلن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْصَلْنَ (istaḥṣalna) /is.taħ.sˤal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# اُسْتُحْصِلْنَ (ustuḥṣilna) /us.tuħ.sˤil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# اِسْتَحْصِلْنَ (istaḥṣilna) /is.taħ.sˤil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
